命名空间 ara::core

用户指南 AI 生成 / AI generated

使用量AI 生成 / AI generated

自动生成的描述、内容源自引用的AUTOSAR-R25-11文档（SWS规范和随附的标准文档）——不是正式的AUTOSAR文本。标记为解释的陈述是从来源得出的结论。

free函数ara::core::Abort[SWS_CORE_00052]终止当前操作并且不返回给调用者。可以使用可变参数args将用户定义的文本插入到输出Log消息中；参数必须可转换为 ara::core::StringView，否则调用格式错误。该函数是线程安全和异常安全的。

并发和限制

由于堆栈未展开，因此不会调用自动存储变量的析构函数。

全球ARA生命周期

Initialize() 初始化数据结构和线程等运行时资源，并打算在静态初始化完成后在 Adaptive Application 启动时执行。事先，只能使用明确批准的 ARA-API。 EXP PlatformDesign §18.4 “Global initialization and shutdown functions” EXP InterfacesGuidelines §3.2 “Startup and Shutdown”

在Deinitialize()之前，应用程序持有的所有 ARA 资源（包括来自其他线程的资源）必须被释放。两个函数都返回Result<void>；如果发生错误，不会提供重试，但应用程序会以错误状态终止。 EXP InterfacesGuidelines §3.2 “Startup and Shutdown”

完全初始化之前的 API 可能会触发实现定义的行为或Violation；在Deinitialize()之后，ARA交互也只允许在狭义定义的例外情况下进行。 EXP PlatformDesign §18.4 “Global initialization and shutdown functions”

活动图：从初始化到使用ARA API 再到取消初始化的推荐生命周期。来源：EXP PlatformDesign §18.4 “Global initialization and shutdown functions”EXP InterfacesGuidelines §3.2 “Startup and Shutdown”。

初始化阶段的框架

并非所有 ARA 功能在初始化之前和取消初始化之后都可用。因此，SWS 只允许明确提到的小子集 - 包括ErrorCode、StringView、Result（ValueOrThrow() 除外）和ErrorDomain（ThrowAsException() 除外） - 无论生命周期如何。 SWS Core §7.1.7 “Initialization/De-initialization”SWS Core §7.1.7.2 “Initialization”[SWS_CORE_15002]

第二次初始化尝试并不是为了重新配置；初始化后，序列规范要求处理错误原因，然后进行新的尝试。在 Deinitialize() 之后，另一个 ARA 调用是在异常之外实现定义的。 SWS Core §7.1.7.4 “Sequence of Initialization and De-initialization” [SWS_CORE_90022]

类与结构体

  • Array Implementation of std::array type from [array.syn] The implicitly-declared special member functions specified in [array.cons] are not expli
  • BasicString Implementation of std::pmr::basic_string type from [basic.string]
  • Bitset Implementation of std::bitset type from [bitset]
  • CoreErrorDomain An error domain for errors originating from the ara::core Functional Cluster.
  • CoreException Exception type thrown for ara::core errors.
  • ErrorCode Encapsulation of an error code
  • ErrorDomain Encapsulation of an ErrorDomain
  • Exception Base type for all ARA exception types
  • Executor Provides an interface for a executing context, which asynchronously invokes Callable ([4] [func.wrap.func]) objects in a guaranteed thread-s
  • Future Implementation of std::future from [future.syn] in [11]
  • Future< void, E > Specialization of class Future for "void" values
  • FutureErrorDomain Error domain for errors originating from ara::core::Future and ara::core::Promise
  • FutureException Exception type thrown by ara::core::Future and ara::core::Promise
  • InstanceSpecifier Representation of an AUTOSAR Instance Specifier, which is basically an AUTOSAR shortName path wrapper.
  • Map Implementation of std::pmr::map container from [map]
  • MemoryResource Implementation of std::pmr::memory_resource type from [mem.res.class]
  • Monostate As per corresponding usage in [variant]
  • MonotonicBufferResource Implementation of std::pmr::monotonic_buffer_resource type from [mem.res.monotonic.buffer]
  • Optional Implementation of std::optional<T> type from [optional.syn]
  • Optional< T & > Specialization of for type T&
  • PolymorphicAllocator Implementation of std::pmr::polymorphic_allocator from [mem.poly.allocator.class]
  • PoolOptions Implementation of std::pmr::pool_options from [mem.poly.pool_options.class]
  • Promise ara::core specific variant of std::promise class The implementation shall flag the condition E!=ara::core::ErrorCode as a compile error.
  • Promise< void, E > Specialization of class Promise for void values The implementation shall flag the condition E != *ara::core::ErrorCode as a compile error.
  • Result This class is a type that contains either a value or an error
  • Result< T &, E > Specialization of class Result for reference to value types
  • Result< void, E > Specialization of class Result for "void" values The implementation shall flag the condition E != ara::core::ErrorCode as a compile error
  • Span Implementation of std::span container from [views.span]
  • SteadyClock This clock represents a monotonic clock
  • StringView Implementation of std::basic_string_view type from [string.view]
  • SynchronizedPoolResource Implementation of std::pmr::synchronized_pool_resource from [mem.res.pool]
  • UnsynchronizedPoolResource Implementation of std::pmr::unsynchronized_pool_resource from [mem.res.pool]
  • Variant Implementation of std::variant type from [basic.string]
  • Vector Implementation of std::pmr::vector container from [vector]
  • hash As per corresponding usage in [bitset]

  • in_place_t Denote an operation to be performed in-place

                                                      函数 Abort [SWS_CORE_00052] Upstream: RS_AP_00127, RS_AP_00159, RS_AP_00136
                                                      

                                                      template <typename... Args> [[noreturn]] void Abort (const Args &...                  args) noexcept;
                                                      

                                                      Abort the current operation This function will never return to its caller. The stack is not unwound: destructors of variables with automatic storage duration are not called. Calling this function is ill-formed if any of the arguments is not convertible to ara::core:: StringView.
                                                      

                                                      使用量AI 生成 / AI generated
                                                      源自此 AUTOSAR R25-11 规范元素的自动生成的使用通知 — 非官方 AUTOSAR 文本。文档：[SWS_…]。
                                                      free函数ara::core::Abort[SWS_CORE_00052]终止当前操作并且不返回给调用者。可以使用可变参数args将用户定义的文本插入到输出Log消息中；参数必须可转换为 ara::core::StringView，否则调用格式错误。该函数是线程安全和异常安全的。
                                                      

                                                      并发和限制
                                                      

                                                      由于堆栈未展开，因此不会调用自动存储变量的析构函数。

                                                                  函数 Deinitialize [SWS_CORE_10002] Upstream: RS_AP_00155
                                                                  

                                                                  Result< void > Deinitialize () noexcept;
                                                                  

                                                                  Shutdown of the ARA Framework After this call, no interaction with the ARA is allowed with the exception of types intended to be used independently of initialization as defined in [SWS_CORE_15002]. As a prerequisite to calling this API it is expected that the use of ARA interfaces has completed (with the given exceptions). It is strongly recommended to make this call in a place where it is guaranteed that the static initialization has completed and destruction of statically initialized data has not yet started.
                                                                  

                                                                  使用量AI 生成 / AI generated
                                                                  自动生成的使用通知源自 AUTOSAR R25-11 规范元素和随附的标准文档 - 非官方 AUTOSAR 文本。
                                                                  ara::core::Deinitialize [SWS_CORE_10002] 关闭ARA 框架。调用后，不允许与ARA进一步交互，但根据[SWS_CORE_15002]可以独立于初始化使用的类型除外。前提是已完成ARA接口的使用；当静态初始化已完成且静态初始化数据的销毁尚未开始时，应发生该调用。该函数不是线程安全的，而是异常安全的。
                                                                  

                                                                  错误处理
                                                                  

                                                                  返回值为 Result<void>：如果成功，则为空值，否则返回 CoreErrc 错误，特别是如果 ARA 当前未初始化或已取消初始化或从未初始化，则为 kNotInitialized。
                                                                  在去初始化之前，其他线程使用的ARA资源也必须被释放；此后，《00001》的互动受到严格限制。 EXP InterfacesGuidelines §3.2 “Startup and Shutdown”EXP PlatformDesign §18.4 “Global initialization and shutdown functions”
                                                                  

                                                                  Header 文件#include "ara/core/initialization.h"
                                                                  Scopenamespace ara::core
                                                                  异常安全exception safe
                                                                  线程安全not thread-safe
                                                                  

                                                                  返回值
                                                                  

                                                                  类型Beschreibung
                                                                  Result< void >• If successful: an ara::core::Result containing a ara:: core::Result::value_type containing a void • If unsuccessful: an ara::core::Result containing an ara:: core::Result::error_type i.e. a corresponding ara:: core::CoreErrc
                                                                  

                                                                  Fehler
                                                                  

                                                                  错误代码Beschreibung
                                                                  CoreErrc::kNotInitializedrollback_semantics ARA is not currently initialized (i.e. has already been successfully de-initialized or has never been initialized)

                                                                          函数 GetDefaultResource [SWS_CORE_06565] Upstream: RS_AP_00130
                                                                          

                                                                          MemoryResource * GetDefaultResource () noexcept;
                                                                          

                                                                          As per corresponding usage in [mem.res] except for the following deviations: 1. Description references to std::pmr::new_delete_resource() are replaced by ara:: core::NewDeleteResource() 2. Description references to std::pmr::set_default_resource() are replaced by ara:: core::SetDefaultResource() 3. Return type std::pmr::memory_resource is replaced with ara::core:: MemoryResource
                                                                          

                                                                          技术分类AI 生成 / AI generated
                                                                          自动补充文档助手的技术分类 - 无规范的 AUTOSAR 文本。
                                                                          该元素的行为并不是在规范中独立制定的，而是参考ISO C++标准部分[mem.res]来定义的；相关对应项是 std::pmr::memory_resource (cppreference: std::pmr::memory_resource) 的同名 std::GetDefaultResource 的免费函数。根据规范与 std 语义的偏差：对 ara 类型的签名适应 (“Description references to std::pmr::new_delete_resource() are replaced by ara:: core::NewDeleteResource()”)；对 ara 类型的签名适配 (“Description references to std::pmr::set_default_resource() are replaced by ara:: core::SetDefaultResource()”)；适应 ara 类型的签名 (“Return type std::pmr::memory_resource is replaced with ara::core :: MemoryResource”)。

                                                                                  函数 Initialize [SWS_CORE_10003] Upstream: RS_AP_00155
                                                                                  

                                                                                  Result< void > Initialize (int &argc, char **argv) noexcept;
                                                                                  

                                                                                  Initialization of the ARA framework. Prior to this call, interaction with the ARA is not allowed with the exception of types intended to be used independently of initialization as defined in [SWS_CORE_15002]. It is strongly recommended to make this call in a place where it is guaranteed that static initialization has completed.
                                                                                  

                                                                                  使用量AI 生成 / AI generated
                                                                                  自动生成的使用通知源自 AUTOSAR R25-11 规范元素和随附的标准文档 - 非官方 AUTOSAR 文本。
                                                                                  ara::core::Initialize [SWS_CORE_10003] 初始化 ARA 框架。在此调用之前，不允许与 ARA 交互，除非根据 [SWS_CORE_15002] 进行初始化而可用的类型除外。当保证静态初始化完成时，应该发生该调用。参数 argc 和 argv 作为 inout 传递，因为可以更改它们以注入和解释制造商特定的配置信息；根据 [SWS_CORE_15006] 删除注入的参数。该函数不是线程安全的，而是异常安全的。
                                                                                  

                                                                                  错误处理
                                                                                  

                                                                                  返回值是 Result<void>，其中包含成功时的 void 值和失败时的 CoreErrc 错误等。 kAlreadyInitialized 如果 ARA 已成功初始化。不正确的配置文件以实现定义的方式处理，作为非标准化违规 [SWS_CORE_00003] 或作为供应商特定的错误代码 [SWS_CORE_00092]。
                                                                                  初始化属于应用程序入口；如果返回的Result<void>失败，则不提供重试。 EXP InterfacesGuidelines §3.2 “Startup and Shutdown”EXP PlatformDesign §18.4 “Global initialization and shutdown functions”
                                                                                  

                                                                                  Header 文件#include "ara/core/initialization.h"
                                                                                  Scopenamespace ara::core
                                                                                  异常安全exception safe
                                                                                  线程安全not thread-safe
                                                                                  

                                                                                  参数（输入/输出）
                                                                                  

                                                                                  范围Beschreibung
                                                                                  argcnumber of elements in argv
                                                                                  argvthe process’s command-line arguments, as received in main()
                                                                                  

                                                                                  返回值
                                                                                  

                                                                                  类型Beschreibung
                                                                                  Result< void >• If successful: an ara::core::Result containing a ara:: core::Result::value_type containing a void • If unsuccessful: an ara::core::Result containing an ara:: core::Result::error_type i.e. a corresponding ara:: core::CoreErrc
                                                                                  

                                                                                  Fehler
                                                                                  

                                                                                  错误代码Beschreibung
                                                                                  CoreErrc::kAlreadyInitializedrollback_semantics ARA has already been initialized and has completed
                                                                                  

                                                                                  Hinweise: Both argc and argv are mutable in the function. This is done to allow injection and interpretation of vendor specific ARA configuration information. The injected arguments are removed in accordance with [SWS_CORE_15006]. Error scenarios, such as corrupted configuration files, are expected to be handled in an implementation-defined way - either as a Non-Standardized Violation ([SWS_CORE_00003]) or as a vendor-specific error code ([SWS_CORE_00092]).
                                                                                  

                                                                                  Request a governed re-review of this record. The record is not changed immediately.

                                                                                                                          函数 SetAbortHandler [SWS_CORE_00051] Upstream: RS_AP_00159
                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                          AbortHandler SetAbortHandler (AbortHandler handler) noexcept;
                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                          Add a custom Abort handler function and return the most recently added one. By setting nullptr, the implementation may restore the default handler instead; this will remove all previously installed handlers. Implementation         This function can be called from multiple threads simultaneously; these calls are performed in an
                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                          使用量AI 生成 / AI generated
                                                                                                                          源自此 AUTOSAR R25-11 规范元素的自动生成的使用通知 — 非官方 AUTOSAR 文本。文档：[SWS_…]。
                                                                                                                          ara::core::SetAbortHandler [SWS_CORE_00051] 注册自定义 Abort handler handler，并返回此前最后安装的 handler（若未安装则返回 nullptr）。如果传递 nullptr，实现可恢复默认 handler，并移除先前安装的所有 handler。
                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                          并发和限制
                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                          该函数可以从多个线程同时调用；调用按实现定义的顺序发生。它为线程安全且 exception safe。

                                                                                                                                                                                      函数 get [SWS_CORE_01613]
                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                      template <std::size_t I, typename... Types> constexpr variant_alternative_t< I, Variant< Types...                         > > & get ( Variant< Types... > &variant) noexcept;
                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                      As per corresponding usage in [variant] except for the following deviations: 1. The function is noexcept 2. if (variant.index() != I) IsoStdBadVariantAccessViolation is raised instead of std:: bad_variant_access
                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                      技术分类AI 生成 / AI generated
                                                                                                                                                                                      自动补充文档助手的技术分类 - 无规范的 AUTOSAR 文本。
                                                                                                                                                                                      该元素的行为在规范中并未独立制定，而是参考ISO-C++标准章节[variant]进行定义；相关的对应项是 std::variant (cppreference: std::variant) 的同名免费函数 std::get。根据规范与 std 语义的偏差：该函数被声明为 noexcept，因此不会通过 Exception 报告错误；触发 std::bad_variant_access，而不是 Violation IsoStdBadVariantAccessViolation（根据规范的条件：“if (variant.index() != I)”）。与可捕获的 std 异常不同，Violation 不可处理：它被视为违反前置/后置条件 ([SWS_CORE_00021])，并通过 Abort() ([SWS_CORE_00090]) 导致异常进程终止。 Record 在 SWS Core 中标记为 DRAFT，因此该内容尚未具有约束力。

                                                                                                                                                                                      受伤 (Violations)IsoStdBadVari-                  Description as per std::bad_variant_access. antAccessViolation
                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                      Request a governed re-review of this record. The record is not changed immediately.

                                                                                                                                                                                              函数 get [SWS_CORE_01615]
                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                              template <std::size_t I, typename... Types> constexpr const variant_alternative_t< I, Variant< Types...                    > > & get (const Variant< Types... > &variant) noexcept;
                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                              As per corresponding usage in [variant] except for the following deviations: 1. The function is noexcept 2. if (variant.index() != I) IsoStdBadVariantAccessViolation is raised instead of std:: bad_variant_access
                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                              技术分类AI 生成 / AI generated
                                                                                                                                                                                              自动补充文档助手的技术分类 - 无规范的 AUTOSAR 文本。
                                                                                                                                                                                              该元素的行为在规范中并未独立制定，而是参考ISO-C++标准章节[variant]进行定义；相关的对应项是 std::variant (cppreference: std::variant) 的同名免费函数 std::get。根据规范与 std 语义的偏差：该函数被声明为 noexcept，因此不会通过 Exception 报告错误；触发 std::bad_variant_access，而不是 Violation IsoStdBadVariantAccessViolation（根据规范的条件：“if (variant.index() != I)”）。与可捕获的 std 异常不同，Violation 不可处理：它被视为违反前置/后置条件 ([SWS_CORE_00021])，并通过 Abort() ([SWS_CORE_00090]) 导致异常进程终止。 Record 在 SWS Core 中标记为 DRAFT，因此该内容尚未具有约束力。

                                                                                                                                                                                                      函数 get [SWS_CORE_01617]

Types> constexpr T & get (Variant< Types... > &variant) noexcept;
                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                      As per corresponding usage in [variant] except for the following deviations: 1. The function is noexcept 2. if (variant does not hold alternative T) IsoStdBadVariantAccessViolation is raised instead of std::bad_variant_access
                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                      技术分类AI 生成 / AI generated
                                                                                                                                                                                                      自动补充文档助手的技术分类 - 无规范的 AUTOSAR 文本。
                                                                                                                                                                                                      该元素的行为在规范中并未单独阐明，而是通过引用 ISO C++ 标准章节 [variant] 定义；对应元素是适用于 std::variant 的同名自由函数 std::get（cppreference: std::variant）。与规范中 std 语义的差异：该函数被声明为 noexcept，因此不会通过 Exception 报告错误；会触发 Violation IsoStdBadVariantAccessViolation，而非 std::bad_variant_access（规范规定的条件：“if (variant does not hold alternative T)”）。与可捕获的 std 异常不同，Violation 不可处理：它被视为遭违反的前置／后置条件（[SWS_CORE_00021]），并通过 Abort()（[SWS_CORE_00090]）导致进程异常终止。该 Record 在 SWS Core 中标记为 DRAFT，因此其内容尚不具约束力。

                                                                                                                                                                                                              该元素的行为在规范中并未单独阐明，而是通过引用 ISO C++ 标准章节 [variant] 定义；对应元素是适用于 std::variant 的同名自由函数 std::get（cppreference: std::variant）。与规范中 std 语义的差异：该函数被声明为 noexcept，因此不会通过 Exception 报告错误；会触发 Violation IsoStdBadVariantAccessViolation，而非 std::bad_variant_access（规范规定的条件：“if (variant does not hold alternative T)”）。与可捕获的 std 异常不同，Violation 不可处理：它被视为遭违反的前置／后置条件（[SWS_CORE_00021]），并通过 Abort()（[SWS_CORE_00090]）导致进程异常终止。该 Record 在 SWS Core 中标记为 DRAFT，因此其内容尚不具约束力。

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          函数 operator!= [SWS_CORE_00781] Upstream: RS_AP_00130
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          template <typename T, typename E> bool operator!= (const Result< T, E > &lhs, const Result< T, E > &rhs);
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Compare two Result instances for inequality. A Result that contains a value is unequal to every Result containing an error. A Result containing a value is equal to another Result only if both contain the same type, and either that type is void or the value of that type compares equal. A Result containing an error is equal to another Result only if both contain the same error type, and the contained errors compare equal.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Header 文件#include "ara/core/result.h"

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          范围Beschreibung
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          lhsthe left hand side of the comparison
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          rhsthe right hand side of the comparison
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          返回值
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          类型Beschreibung
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          booltrue if the two instances compare unequal, false otherwise

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              constexpr bool operator== (const ErrorCode &lhs, const ErrorCode &rhs) noexcept;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Comparison of two ErrorCodes. Two ErrorCode instances compare equal if the results of their Value() and Domain() functions are equal. The result of SupportData() is not considered for equality.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  函数 operator== [SWS_CORE_00780] Upstream: RS_AP_00130
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  template <typename T, typename E> bool operator== (const Result< T, E > &lhs, const Result< T, E > &rhs);
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Compare two Result instances for equality. A Result that contains a value is unequal to every Result containing an error. A Result containing a value is equal to another Result only if both contain the same type, and either that type is void or the value of that type compares equal. A Result containing an error is equal to another Result only if both contain the same error type, and the contained errors compare equal.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      函数 operator== [SWS_CORE_00782] Upstream: RS_AP_00130

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          函数 operator== [SWS_CORE_00783] Upstream: RS_AP_00130
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          template <typename T, typename E> bool operator== (const T &lhs, const Result< T, E > &rhs);
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Compare a Result instance for equality to a value. A Result that contains no value is unequal to every value. A Result is equal to a value only if the Result contains a value of the same type, and the values compare equal.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          函数 swap [SWS_CORE_01096]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          template <typename T> void swap (Optional< T > &lhs, Optional< T > &rhs) noexcept(std::is_ nothrow_move_constructible< T >::value &&std::is_nothrow_move_ assignable< T >::value);
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          As per corresponding usage in [optional] except for the following deviations: 1. noexcept specifier conditions are modified
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          技术分类AI 生成 / AI generated
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          自动补充文档助手的技术分类 - 无规范的 AUTOSAR 文本。
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          该元素的行为不是在规范中独立制定的，而是参考 ISO C++ 标准部分 [optional] 定义的；相关的对应项是 std::optional (cppreference: std::optional) 的同名自由函数 std::swap。根据规范，与 std 语义的偏差：该函数被声明为 noexcept，因此不会通过异常报告错误。该记录在 SWS 核心中标记为 DRAFT，因此内容尚未绑定。
